why.rfc3550_rfc3611|1: received_interval is a local variable in the example code of Appendix A.3, not an RTCP field (checker A and checker B agree)
why.rfc3550_rfc3611|9: the official definition of jitter is the standard deviation of arrival intervals within a window; mean_jitter is the mean of the relative transit time (or |D|), a different definition (checker B judged it wrong, checker A was unsure)
why.gstreamer_rtpmanager|0: bitrate-recv belongs to twcc-stats and is computed only at the sender from TWCC feedback; according to the direction rule set before the run for the W3C fractionLost it should be the same quantity (checker A and checker B agree)
why.gstreamer_rtpmanager|10: packet-loss-pct is likewise sender-side twcc-stats; the receiver-side same quantity sent-rb-fractionlost is not among the presented fields (checker A and checker B agree)
why.quic_qlog|8: Subtracting the time of adjacent packet_received events gives the inter-arrival interval, which is event aggregation, the same basis as qlog features 0, 1, 2 (checker A and checker B agree)
why.w3c_webrtc_stats|12: Grouping packetsReceived of each stream by kind can combine into a proportion, which is a multi-field combination (checker B judged wrong, checker A was unsure)
why.*|3: Sources with a round-trip time field can derive a same-category queueing quantity (round-trip rather than one-way) by subtracting the minimum round-trip time from the round-trip time; checker B labelled it a different definition, checker A maintained none, and it is labelled a different definition in the direction unfavorable to the LLM
why.*|5: Sources with a round-trip time field can track the historical minimum of the round-trip time; this is an additional computation and is round-trip, so it is labelled a different definition
why.rfc3550_rfc3611|12: Classifying packet by packet by payload type and then counting can give a proportion, which is aggregation, labelled a different definition (conservative)
why.quic_qlog|3: smoothed_rtt minus min_rtt is the same quantity in round-trip terms
why.quic_qlog|11: packet_lost events can be aggregated into loss events, which is aggregation by event, classified as same quantity (conservative)
why.linux_tcp_info|3: tcpi_rtt minus tcpi_min_rtt is the same quantity in round-trip terms

rule: Same quantity: a single presented field, itself or the difference of two readings multiplied by a constant, equals the officially defined feature, and is measured at the receiver for the inbound stream; similar: requires additional computation (rate, average, event aggregation, multi-field combination, tracking historical minimum) or a different definition (round trip, smoothed estimate, sender side, frame, expected packet count) or is not a real field; none: the presented field, alone or in combination, does not involve this quantity. Disputed cases are classified as similar.
